name: Pair of K16 turbochargers of the 993 Turbo
description: Research target of the digital twin: two K16 turbochargers mounted in parallel on the 993 Turbo. This record establishes the functional identity and the available public data; it constitutes neither a replacement geometry nor a manufacturing authorization.

classification.intended_use: Research, identification, simulation and dimensional reconstruction under engineering control; no engine or road use at this stage

provenance.record_license: MIT for the record, no third-party geometry redistributed

sources.title: Porsche Christophorus - Technical data of the 911 Turbo (993)
sources.notes: Parallel twin-turbo architecture, 3,600 cm3, 0.8 bar, 408 hp, 540 Nm and integrated wastegate.

sources.title: BorgWarner - Performance Turbocharger Catalog
sources.notes: Commercial association of the 993 Turbo with the K16-6735 and K16-6736; no complete geometry.

sources.title: FVD Brombacher - envelope and mass of the 993 K16s
sources.notes: Product declarations: 280 x 190 x 210 mm and 5.6 kg for the right-hand K16 99312301452; the left-hand page 99312301352 states 5.76 kg with the same envelope. See SRC-FVD-993-K16-OEM-DIMENSIONS.

sources.title: Invasion Auto Products - internal catalog data of the right-hand K16
sources.notes: Declarations of part numbers, inducer/exducer diameters, housing clocking angles, A/R and wastegate setting for 53169886735; no aero surface, tolerance or CAD. See SRC-INVASIONAUTOPRODUCTS-993-K16-INTERNAL-DATA.

sources.title: Design911 - Cross-reference of the 993 Turbo K16 turbochargers
sources.notes: Left/right Porsche and BorgWarner cross-reference, to be confirmed on a turbo data plate or a primary source.

sources.title: TurboMaster - Exploded parts view of the BorgWarner K16 5316-988-6735
sources.notes: Subassembly part numbers and declared A/R; no metrology drawing.

sources.title: Porsche Fanatics - PET transcription of the 993 turbo groups
sources.notes: The site's local repository exposes PET groups 202-16, 107-20 and 107-45: bill of materials for the turbochargers, lines, control, forced induction and intercooler. The lines are PET transcriptions, with no dimensions, tolerances or CAD; see SRC-PORSCHEFANATICS-993-TURBO-PET.

sources.title: Porsche Austria - PET 993, group 107-45 air cooler
sources.notes: Official PET plate used to cross-check the part numbers, fittings, gaskets and clamps of the forced induction circuit; it provides no passage dimensions and no CAD. See SRC-PORSCHE-AUSTRIA-993-107-45-PET.

known_limits: No K16 unit, K16 data plate, K16 physical measurement, K16 scan or licensed K16 CAD is available in the project; K16 masses and envelopes are now available as supplier declarations, without tolerances or interfaces.
The left/right part numbers come from public cross-references and must be confirmed on a part or in an authorized Porsche source.

FVD declares 5.76 kg for the left-hand K16 and 5.6 kg for the right-hand K16, with a product envelope of 280 x 190 x 210 mm; these values serve the envelope and mass check, not the reconstruction of the bare turbo.

Invasion Auto Products declares wheel diameters for the right-hand K16 (turbine 54.96/48.97 mm; compressor 40.6/60.5 mm), part numbers and an A/R of 8; these values must be confirmed before any wheel geometry or rotordynamic calculation.
No compressor/turbine map, efficiency curve, mass flow, maximum speed, tip clearance, axial/radial play, oil pressure or turbine inlet temperature has been collected.
The part numbers for wheels, housings, CHRA, actuator and A/R are supplier catalog declarations; they define neither the aero surfaces nor the tolerances.
The local Porsche 993 manual is a source of service procedures and specifications; it does not provide a complete CAD definition of the K16 here.

The Porsche Fanatics transcription adds a PET bill of materials for groups 202-16, 107-20 and 107-45, but no new dimensional measurement; the listed lines must be read in context before any fitment conclusion.
A turbine wheel, a compressor wheel, a shaft, a bearing or a hot housing are loaded, thermal and/or rotating parts: no printing, fitment, engine test or road use is authorized by this record.
The twin's first demonstrator must target a non-rotating cold-side duct or adapter, with an envelope prototype before any metal version.
